ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Prayer times and the qibla direction are calculated for where you are. If you don’t allow it, you can pick your city manually.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: The qibla compass uses the motion sensor to read which way your phone is facing.
ios.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: This permission is only used to make ads more relevant to you. If you don’t allow it, ads are still shown and no feature of the app is limited.
